reply: You can search for books by title, author, or category using the library catalog. Please provide the book title or author's name to help locate the book. This demo does not connect to a live catalog, so it cannot confirm actual availability.

Please return borrowed books to the library circulation desk or the designated book-return box. Return books by their due dates to avoid possible late fees. Contact library staff if you have lost or damaged a book.

You can check a book's due date on your borrowing receipt or in your library account, if online accounts are available. You may also ask the circulation desk. Contact the library to ask whether renewal is possible before the due date.

To borrow a book, present your valid library membership card at the circulation desk. Library staff will check availability and your borrowing eligibility. Borrowing limits and loan periods depend on library policy.

Library rules generally include maintaining silence, keeping books in good condition, returning books on time, and presenting a valid membership card when borrowing. For exact opening hours, membership requirements, borrowing limits, and fees, please contact your library staff.
Hello! Welcome to the Library Management Helpdesk. I can help you with book searches, borrowing, returns, due dates, and library rules. What would you like to know?
You're welcome! I'm happy to help with your library questions.
